_comment: Single source of truth for vessel IDs. Backend outputs and 3D meshes are keyed by `id`. Model targets reference these via vessel_id in ml/configs/targets.yaml.

vessels.name: Left Anterior Descending artery
vessels.supplies: Front (anterior) wall of the left ventricle and most of the septum between the ventricles.

vessels.name: Left Circumflex artery
vessels.supplies: Side (lateral) and back (posterior) walls of the left ventricle.

vessels.name: Right Coronary Artery
vessels.supplies: Right ventricle and the bottom (inferior) wall of the heart; usually the heart's natural pacemaker nodes.
